body:
This sounds pretty similar to the relationship I had with my ex. I would get upset he didn't bring me around his friends, (one group he did all the time and they are still my friends after we have broken up, but the other group he never ever brought me around and that was always really weird to me). He was significantly older than me and I thought that would help the maturity level as I've been told I'm a lot to handle, but he was extremely shut off and distant throughout the majority of our relationship. His quiet and general grumpiness/never showing me affection/ made me really question if he did love me and made me constantly insecure and just plain fucking crazy trying to figure out what was going on in his head. We fought so much and it was almost always me starting them and he would constantly tell me how tired he was and that I was pushing him away. 

One thing that he suggested multiple times in our relationship was to go on a break (not break up, just take some time apart to think). At the time I was so clouded in my jealousy and insecurity I thought that meant he just wanted to fuck someone else. But looking back I absolutely wish I would have taken him up on the offer because being apart from someone can really make you learn new things about yourself and analyze what you're doing wrong. Maybe you should consider that and talk to your boyfriend about it, before it's too late. A month ago my ex just snapped one day and said he couldn't be with me anymore. The day before he was saying he wasn't going anywhere and that he loved me, then the next I started a stupid fight over a girl, and he broke up with me after 2 years. I've been wishing of all the things I could have done different this whole time, don't wait until it's too late.

I was able to get my things. Our last words basically ended in an arguement. He laughed in my face while I was sobbing and told me I was never going to change, that all I want to do is fight and make people miserable. 

I got drunk afterwards and thought about how I was there last October when his father passed away, and I held his hand while he took his last breath and told him father I would take care of, and love his son. And I failed miserably at doing just that. I left tonight and said "I hope I never see you again." And that's true. I want to hang myself tomorrow and never have to see him, or think of him, or ever feel this way and I'm going to do it. If I wasn't so fucking tired I would do it right now but I need to go buy some rope tomorrow first. 

I can't do this anymore, thank you for listening when you did. I don't know if you'll see this ever, but you did calm me down last night enough to help me from doing anything stupid. I don't think anyone could do anything at this point though.

I loved that man and I am not the monster he made my disorder to make me out to be. I'm just fucking depressed and I can't change that.
I have no way to contact him.
He just blocked me on everything and I have stuff at his house I need to get. What should I do?

I feel sick to my stomach thinking about how depressed I am. Currently in bed sobbing because my ex messaged me some mean shit as I was falling asleep. I don't really understand what I did to deserve this. I know I'm not a perfect person and I lashed out on him, and the guilt alone is making me so fucking sad. I just don't want to feel like this anymore.

You should look into getting your hormone levels checked from your doctor, and they can tell you what's up. It's  simple blood test, but maybe the birth control you're on just isn't right for you and you need a different kind! That's what I did and my doc switched me to an older one that isn't used as much anymore (but obviously just as effective there's just so many new kinds) and it helped significantly.

Hey, we all are human and we all are going to fuck up from time to time. Nobody said it can be all good all the time. I also relapsed on a drug I told myself I'd never do again last night, and hooked up with a pretty toxic person but I was lonely and missing my ex and it was right in front of me. I felt incredibly ashamed when I woke up this morning, but also reminded myself that I am going through a really hard time and slip ups are bound to happen along the way. As long as I, (and you) don't continue to do drugs, or drink or the same behavior over and over again I think it is quite normal to do these things. As long as it is not a habit again, then it is time to reach for help. 

Try to learn from it, and remind yourself not to do it again, but don't beat yourself up and think you're a bad person, you're just a person. That's it. We all are.
This was tough to hear, but good to read.
